issue.title: Try now lifts nothing when another magpie serves the gateway (unrest answers 400)
issue.body:
Found while fixing zoecats' report (Discord #feedback, 10-25: Try now in the provider's editor left Routing showing 429 until a restart).

When another magpie serves the gateway (this window plays its trace through `OwnerTrace`, `/v1/magpie/trace`), this process's `served` is nil (`gui.Handler` gets `gw == nil`). So `POST /api/gateway/unrest` in `internal/gui/trace.go` answers 400 "nothing to lift" and the Try now buttons, in the provider's editor (app.js key/account rows) and on Routing, lift nothing: the rest is held in the other magpie's memory.

Read in the source only; not reproduced with two magpies running.

What would fix it: forward the lift to the owner like the trace is read (an owner route beside `/v1/magpie/trace`, behind the same loopback/key check), or say in the button's place that the other magpie holds the rest.

comments.body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/3555-unrest-owner` (head `1fe501d2`, on upstream `6afbe3f3`) — "Try now" forwards the lift to the magpie that serves the gateway.

**Root cause.** `internal/gui/trace.go`'s `POST /api/gateway/unrest` did `gw := served.Load()` and answered 400 "nothing to lift" when nil — when another magpie serves the gateway there is nothing local to lift, and the request stopped there.

**Change.** a forwarding counterpart to `OwnerTrace`, `OwnerUnrest` in `internal/gateway/trace.go`, reusing the same owner URL, client and held-key gate; the GUI handler calls it before answering 400, and unattended fields stay as they were when no owner answers.

**Verified.** Red: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gui/ -run TestTryNowLiftsARestOfTheServingMagpie` → `400 nothing to lift` against a fake owner that serves the unrest endpoint
Green: `same command → `ok`; the owner receives the key and lifts it; with no owner the answer is still 400; `./internal/gui` 39s ok` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gui`

The new endpoint sits behind the same loopback/key checks as the trace one; `UnrestAll`'s callers in app.js send the same shape and needed no change.

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 26's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6afbe3f3` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3555-unrest-owner — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
